fact: The REALISE project page says all its transfers are delivered digitally through MTN mobile money and that the Liberia Household Social Registry means no new targeting or payment system is needed, as at the 6 May 2026 meeting.
The World Bank blog says the Liberia Household Social Registry and the project MIS are used by three government-led social protection programmes.

The ministry page says the operational Social Registry Information System and Integrated MIS let the LSSNP, the REALISE project and social protection partners streamline operations on the Liberia Household Social Registry, which holds 252,662 households.
The World Bank status report says enhancements to the social protection system, including the social registry, are ongoing in preparation for integration with other national systems.
The World Bank report gives 5 social protection programmes (SCT, LIPW, SSB and CLAS) using the Liberia Household Social Registry at 9 June 2025, up from 4 in December 2024, against a target of 6.

The IEG review says three social protection programmes (SCT-COVID, SCT Phase 2 and the labour-intensive public works programme under P174417) used the Liberia Household Social Registry as an intake tool, while the MIS had yet to serve programmes outside Bank financing.
